dedupe_keys.name: the long term energy planning with highly detailed demand modelling for egypt an ioa maed osemosys soft linking approach

description: The Long-term energy planning with highly detailed demand modelling for Egypt: an IOA-MAED-OSeMOSYS soft-linking approach is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. These files contain an updated model built for Egypt's power system as of 2023, with detailed demand simulation in 3 different scenarios; business as usual, high economic growth and industrial energy efficiency. Also, a multi region model built for Egypt, Sudan and Ethiopia power sector technologies for future cooperation scenarios. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Energy Modelling, Demand simulation, multi-region model. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
